title: jam-actions-v0 (public subset) — AI Jam Sessions tool-use traces
notes: Superseded on 2026-09-25 by version 0.6.0 (10.5281/zenodo.22961580), a correction release. This version contains 58 records whose source arrangements have no established licence; its files are restricted. Earlier notes: Version 0.5.0 is a record-content correction release (errata 001 + 002, Bach BWV 846) published as a new version under the concept DOI; the v0.4.3 deposit is unchanged. A PASS verdict on the RC gate (release-gate-assessment/2.0.0) does NOT mean the dataset is approved for release; per the source-repo doctrine 'gate clearance is not release approval.' The RC gate's evidence base is the sealed E3 baseline measured on v0.4.3 records; a successor baseline measured on v0.5.0 records ships with a future version. See KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md for honest scope (8 songs, single-arranger, piano-only, English-only annotations). See RELEASE_NOTES.md for the full version arc 0.1.0 → 0.5.0. On 2026-09-26 the source repository's history was rewritten; the jam-actions-v0 tag named in this record now points to a rewritten commit whose tree no longer holds the withdrawn records. The full map is in docs/findings/history-rewrite/ in mcp-tool-shop-org/ai-jam-sessions.
